\section{Complete Experimental Results}
\label{app:full-results}

This appendix presents the full experimental data underlying the main paper.
All results are drawn from 890 logged experiments across 37 experimental stages,
spanning probing, steering, layer selection, scheduling, composition, two-stage methods,
quality evaluation, Feynman--Kac comparison, adaptive steering, orthogonality analysis,
CLIP evaluation, FID evaluation, Pareto analysis, and Wang et al.\ comparison.

%% Summary Statistics (inline)
%% ============================================================
\subsection{Summary Statistics}
\label{app:summary-stats}

\noindent\textbf{Scale.}
The full experimental log contains \textbf{890 experiments} across \textbf{37 distinct stages}.

\noindent\textbf{Concepts tested.}
We evaluated steering on 9 concepts:
\emph{brightness} (primary),
\emph{colorfulness},
\emph{warmth},
\emph{texture},
\emph{contrast},
\emph{animal} (semantic),
\emph{natural} (semantic),
plus 5 ImageNet classes (golden\_retriever, tabby\_cat, giant\_panda, daisy, bubble).

\noindent\textbf{Extraction methods.}
Four vector extraction methods were compared:
mean difference (MD),
PCA,
logistic regression (LogReg),
and Recursive Feature Machines (RFM).

\noindent\textbf{Layer configurations.}
We tested steering at individual layers 0--27 (28 layers),
plus 25 named layer combinations (Table~\ref{tab:a6-layer-combos}),
and 8 layer-adaptive profiles.

\noindent\textbf{Top 5 configurations by lift (DiT-XL/2).}
\begin{enumerate}[nosep]
\item SD15v2 brightness all\_blocks $\varepsilon{=}{-}5$, frac$=$0.3: lift $= +0.790$ (S2-SDv2; Stable Diffusion 1.5)
\item SD15v2 brightness down\_all $\varepsilon{=}{-}5$, frac$=$0.3: lift $= +0.720$ (S2-SDv2; Stable Diffusion 1.5)
\item SD15v2 brightness down\_0 $\varepsilon{=}{-}5$, frac$=$0.3: lift $= +0.660$ (S2-SDv2; Stable Diffusion 1.5)
\item LASD layer0 norm\_scale $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.1$: lift $= +0.620$ (S8-FK; DiT-XL/2)
\item Two-stage layer0 norm\_scale $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.5$: lift $= +0.615$ (S6; DiT-XL/2)
\end{enumerate}

\noindent\textbf{Top 5 configurations by FID (lower is better, DiT-XL/2).}
\begin{enumerate}[nosep]
\item Layer0 MD $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.1$: FID $= 60.654$
\item Brightness $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.2$: FID $= 60.950$ (Pareto)
\item Brightness $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.05$: FID $= 61.481$ (Pareto)
\item Brightness $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.1$: FID $= 61.665$ (Pareto)
\item First5 MD $\varepsilon{=}{-}0.5$: FID $= 61.822$
\end{enumerate}

\noindent\textbf{Key negative results.}
Semantic concepts (animal, natural) showed zero lift across all 72 configurations tested in S7-SEM,
including extreme $\varepsilon$ values ($\pm 20$) and no-clip conditions.
Contrast showed consistently negative lift (best: $-0.010$).
Norm-scaling (Wang et al.) collapsed diversity to 0.000 on all-layer configurations.
RFM vectors were orthogonal to mean-difference vectors ($\cos < 0.04$ at every layer).
